signals.headline: AI182 inbound aircraft is running late at Delhi
signals.body: The aircraft operating your Mumbai → Dubai service arrived into Delhi 3h 10m behind schedule. Airline has not yet republished the departure time.
signals.tripImpact: AI182 is the first flight of your trip. Everything on Day 1 sits downstream of it.

signals.headline: Heavy pre-monsoon showers over Mumbai
signals.body: IMD nowcast shows 40–60 mm of rain across the western suburbs between 06:00 and 11:00, with gusts to 45 km/h.
signals.tripImpact: Ground holds at BOM are likely in exactly the window AI182 departs. Budget extra time to reach the airport.

signals.headline: DXB averaging 40-minute departure delays
signals.body: Runway 12L/30R resurfacing has reduced departure capacity through 6 June. Arrivals are unaffected.
signals.tripImpact: Your Dubai → Paris flight departs inside the constrained window. Your CDG transfer has a 55-minute buffer, which absorbs most of this.

signals.headline: Shamal winds forecast over the Gulf on Monday evening
signals.body: Onshore winds of 30–38 km/h expected between 16:00 and 22:00 Gulf time, easing overnight.
signals.tripImpact: The Sunset Dhow Cruise is weather-sensitive. Operators suspend sailings above 35 km/h, so your Day 1 evening has a real chance of being cancelled at the pier.

signals.headline: RATP staff action affecting RER B
signals.body: Reduced service on the CDG branch of RER B announced for Wednesday 3 June, roughly 1 train in 2.
signals.tripImpact: Both of your Paris airport transfers run along the RER B corridor. Your booked cars are unaffected, but road traffic will be heavier if the action goes ahead.

signals.headline: Elevated pickpocket advisory around Châtelet
signals.body: Local police report a seasonal rise in opportunistic theft around Châtelet–Les Halles interchange.
signals.tripImpact: Your Le Marais hotel is a 6-minute walk from Châtelet, and your Louvre tour starts on the far side of it.

signals.headline: Showers clearing over Paris by Wednesday
signals.body: A weak front passes Tuesday night. Thursday is forecast dry, 21°C, light winds.
signals.tripImpact: Eiffel summit access closes in high wind. Thursday's forecast is comfortably within limits for your 16:00 timed entry.

signals.headline: French ATC action notified for 4 June
signals.body: A national controllers' union has filed notice for a 24-hour action. Long-haul departures are usually protected first.
signals.tripImpact: Your return flight departs on 5 June, one day after the notified action. Knock-on aircraft positioning delays are possible.

signals.headline: Flash flooding across coastal Karnataka
signals.body: Red alert issued for four districts. Rail services suspended between Mangaluru and Karwar.
signals.tripImpact: No connection to your itinerary. Shown because it sits inside your monitored region.

signals.headline: Istanbul Airport recovering from overnight fog
signals.body: Arrival rates back to normal after a 3-hour low-visibility procedure period.
signals.tripImpact: Not on your route. No effect on your trip.

signals.headline: Dubai Metro Red Line running to normal timetable
signals.body: No reported service issues. First train 05:00, last train 00:00.
signals.tripImpact: A working backup for your airport transfer if the booked car falls through — ₹320 for the party, step-free the whole way.

signals.headline: UAE entry requirements unchanged for Indian passport holders
signals.body: Visa on arrival remains available for eligible travellers with a valid US/UK/EU visa or residence permit.
signals.tripImpact: No action needed before your Dubai arrival.

seasonal.weather: 42–46°C, humid. Occasional shamal winds in the evening.
seasonal.activityAvailability: Outdoor tours run early morning or after sunset only. Desert and water activities operate normally.
seasonal.tripImpact: Both of your Dubai experiences are outdoor and weather-sensitive. Your Sunset Dhow Cruise sits inside the evening wind window, and your City Tour is an open-top bus in mid-40s heat.
recommendations: Keep the cruise as an evening slot rather than moving it earlier
Prefer the 09:00 City Tour slot over 14:00
Carry the operator's weather-cancellation policy — the cruise is non-refundable

seasonal.activityAvailability: Everything open. Museum queues build sharply after 11:00.
seasonal.tripImpact: Your Louvre tour is on a Wednesday, which is the museum's busiest late-opening day. Your Eiffel summit entry can close in high wind. Industrial action is the main transport risk on your two airport transfers.
recommendations: Hold the 10:00 Louvre slot rather than the afternoon one
Keep a refundable backup for the Eiffel summit
Leave 30 extra minutes for the departure transfer on 5 June

seasonal.weather: Monsoon onset. 28–31°C with heavy intermittent rain.
seasonal.activityAvailability: Coastal and outdoor activity availability drops sharply.
seasonal.tripImpact: Your outbound flight leaves at the start of the monsoon window. Waterlogging on the Western Express Highway routinely adds 45–60 minutes to airport journeys, and BOM issues ground holds in heavy cells.
recommendations: Leave for the airport 60 minutes earlier than usual
Your AI182 fare is non-refundable — consider a flexible fare next time
Add a buffer day before any onward international connection

seasonal.activityAvailability: Beach shacks closed, water sports suspended, ferries intermittent.
seasonal.tripImpact: Not part of your current itinerary — shown as a reference destination profile.
recommendations: Add a buffer day around any coastal transfer
Move outdoor activities to the first half of the day

plans.explanation: Lowest cost preserves 2 of 5 experiences and costs ₹4,760 more. No arrival lands in the late-night window you asked us to avoid. Dubai City Tour and Montmartre Food Walk and Eiffel Summit & Seine Walk are the only things given up, and they were the lowest-priority items competing for that time. ₹25,060 of what you already paid cannot be recovered on these terms. 11 bookings change across 4 days.

recommendation: Save the experiences is recommended because it preserves 4/5 experiences. You told us experiences matter most, so that is what we optimised for.
